verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence publishes operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts for the My DOR online filing or licensing flow before a user starts. The only availability statement covers the automated phone line (24/7), which is a different channel. The draft-save feature is adjacent and does not disclose any timeout or window. The transactional portal could not be inspected because it sits behind a login wall.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
